channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Balkans snow in the last days: which country got the most? Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Montenegro and Bulgaria compared
item.description: From 13 to 19 November 2026 Slovenia got the most snow and kept it; Serbia and Croatia had a deep but short white weekend; Montenegro only on Durmitor; Bulgaria almost none. The ranking, with links to each country report.

item.title: Bulgaria snow: Bansko, Borovets and Pamporovo almost bare on 19 November, what next week brings
item.description: Only Borovets and Bansko have a trace of snow at the top today, 2 cm each. A week ago Borovets had 11 cm. Day by day, and the one snowy day in the forecast.

item.title: Serbia snow this week: a short white weekend on Zlatibor, Kopaonik still waiting
item.description: Tornik on Zlatibor had up to 39 cm on its upper slopes on 15 November 2026; by Wednesday it had melted. Kopaonik barely turned white. The week day by day and what comes next.

item.title: Montenegro snow this week: Durmitor kept it, Kolašin did not (19 November 2026)
item.description: Savin Kuk above Žabljak picked up 22 cm of snow from 13 to 19 November and still has 6 cm today. Kolašin 1450 and 1600 are bare. The week day by day, and the next chances.

item.title: Cheapest lift tickets in the western US for 2026-27: ski midweek for $49 to $99
item.description: Seven independent ski areas in the West where an adult day ticket costs from $49 to $98.8 on weekdays, compared with the snow they usually have in December.

item.title: How to use the SnowScope ski trip planner
item.description: Pick a region, dates, budget and what matters; get every resort ranked with the likely snow at the start, the pass, hotel and food per person, chalets to book, and a game mode.

item.title: Croatia snow: Gorski kotar and Velebit turned white on 13 November, then it melted
item.description: Up to 30 cm of snow fell on northern Velebit and Bjelolasica on Friday 13 November 2026. By Tuesday it was gone. Day by day, what the mountains kept, and when snow comes back.

item.title: South Lake Tahoe's deepest 19 November in 46 winters: Heavenly, Sierra-at-Tahoe and Mt. Rose
item.description: Heavenly, Sierra-at-Tahoe and Mt. Rose have more snow on 19 November than in any winter since 1980-81. How much fell, the measured gauges, the weather behind it and the best days to go.

item.title: Slovenia snow today: fresh snow on Kanin, Krvavec and Pokljuka, 19 November 2026
item.description: Snow is falling on Slovenia's ski mountains today: about 37 cm on Kanin and 21 cm on Krvavec. Where the snow lies, how it compares with past winters, and the next snowy day.

item.title: Cheapest ski day pass in the Alps for 2026-27, and where you get the most runs
item.description: Alpine day passes from 36 EUR: nine resorts compared by price, kilometres of runs and the snow they usually hold, to find the best day of skiing for your money.

item.title: Cheapest ski resorts in the Pyrenees for 2026-27, and the month to go
item.description: Pyrenees day passes from 46 EUR: six resorts in France, Spain and Andorra compared by price, then by the snow they usually have in December and January.

item.title: Cheapest glacier ski pass for 2026-27: seven snow-sure glaciers compared
item.description: Glacier skiing from 68 EUR a day: we compared seven glaciers in France, Austria, Germany and Switzerland by price and by the snow they usually hold in December.

item.title: Hakuba's first big snowstorm of 2026-27: snow at the top, rain at the base (19-25 November)
item.description: Hakuba Happo-one gets about 1.7 m of new snow at the top lift from 19 to 25 November, but rain at the base until 20 November. Day-by-day forecast at three heights.

item.title: Cheapest 6-day ski pass in Europe 2026-27, and which ones really have snow
item.description: Six days of skiing from 191 EUR: we ranked ten cheap ski weeks in Europe by price, then checked 46 past winters to see where the snow is reliable.

item.title: Early-season ski deals 2026: the cheapest opening weeks in the Alps
item.description: From 20 EUR on an opening weekend to 6-day passes before Christmas: a calendar of the cheapest early-season ski deals in the Alps for 2026, with the snow you can expect.

item.title: Japan ski resorts snow forecast, 20-25 November 2026: Hakuba close to a metre, Hokkaido lighter
item.description: New snow forecast for 15 Japanese ski resorts from 20 to 25 November: Hakuba and Tsugaike lead with about 90 to 97 cm at the top, Niseko about 35 cm.

item.title: Snow in Japan today: bare towns on 19 November, a big storm for the mountains
item.description: Only 3 of 318 snow stations in Japan had snow on the ground this morning. Here is where it is, what melted this week, and where the next snow falls.

item.title: Northeast snow depth 18 Nov: what to wear on thin cover and warming days
item.description: Only 16 US Northeast resorts have skiable snow on 18 Nov. Thin cover and rain-crust risk mean careful gear choices. Forecasts for 19-21 Nov show no new snow.

item.title: Sunshine Village snow forecast: 1,500 m freezing level brings rain risk Thursday
item.description: Freezing level reaches 1,500 m at Banff Sunshine Village on November 19. Fresh snow fell across Western Canada in the last 72 hours, but rain threatens the new powder.

item.title: Western Canada: 90 cm in 14 days, most falling in week two
item.description: Western Canada forecast: 90 cm new snow at Mount Washington in the next two weeks, with 70 cm expected in late November and early December. Model run 2026-11-18.

item.title: Alpine Meadows ski resort snow report: four times the November average
item.description: Fresh snow across the US West has built depths well above normal. At Palisades Tahoe Alpine Meadows, upper slopes hold 75 cm (measured 2026-11-18), compared to 10 cm typical for mid-November.

item.title: Germany: 29 cm of snow forecast over the next week, peaking on 25 November
item.description: German mountains face significant snow arrival over seven days, with up to 29 cm possible. Data from 18 November.

item.title: Romania: 25 cm new snow forecast in next week, peak on 23 November
item.description: Romania's mountains will see up to 25 cm of new snow in the next 7 days, with 12 cm expected on 23 November. Snow depth and forecast as of 18 November.

item.title: UK snow by range: Southern Uplands lead with 24 cm in three days
item.description: Fresh snow fell unevenly across the UK hills in the past 72 hours. The Southern Uplands received the most, while cover above 1000 m is now complete. Data from 18 November.

item.title: Ukraine loses 1,920 km² of snow cover in one day as mild air moves through
item.description: A sudden thaw on 18 November removed most of Ukraine's snow cover in 24 hours. Only 430 km² remained, down from 2,350 km² yesterday. New snow is forecast.

item.title: Where did Slovakia's snow go? 490 km² melted in one day
item.description: Mild weather erased nearly 490 km² of snow cover across Slovakia on 18 November. The High Tatras still hold 17 cm of new snow from the past 72 hours.

item.title: 27 Finnish resorts with snow cover: where the best base is building
item.description: 27 of Finland's 67 resorts have snow on 18 November. Upper slopes above 1000 m hold 41 cm on average across the country.

item.title: Zermatt 47 cm: nine times deeper than a normal November
item.description: Zermatt has 47 cm on upper slopes today, 690% above the November median. The 0°C level stays above 2200 m through Friday.

item.title: Austria: glaciers ahead, Stubaier Gletscher reaches 72 cm
item.description: Austria's glacier resorts lead the country after 14 cm fell in the last 72 hours. Snow cover grew to 18,140 km² as of 18 November.

item.title: Where did France's snow land? Mont Blanc massif leads with 180 cm in three days
item.description: Fresh snow fell across France's high mountains in the past 72 hours. The Mont Blanc massif received the most: 180 cm. Data from 2026-11-18.

item.title: Switzerland: Glacier 3000 leads at nearly double the typical mid-November depth
item.description: Swiss ski areas are running 142% of normal snow cover for November 18. Glacier 3000 tops the ranking with 52 cm, ahead of major storms forecast.

item.title: Will the Alps get fresh snow this week? Up to 228 cm in the next two weeks
item.description: New snow forecast for the Alps through early December. Saint François Longchamp leads with 228 cm expected over 14 days, starting with 35 cm on Thursday.

item.title: Italy: 95 cm incoming over the next week, with Friday as the heaviest day
item.description: Italy faces a major snow event: up to 95 cm is forecast for the next 7 days, with 34 cm expected on Friday 20 November. Data from 18 November.

item.title: Les Grands Montets: 74 cm of New Snow in 72 Hours
item.description: Les Grands Montets saw 74 cm of new snow in the last 72 hours, with more forecast for the coming days, according to our model on November 17, 2026.

item.title: Italy loses 8,670 km² of snow in one day as mild weather brings thaw
item.description: Rapid snow loss across Italy on 17 November as temperatures rise. Only 12,540 km² remains covered, down from 21,210 km² yesterday. The Aosta Valley saw 134 cm of new snow in 72 hours.

item.title: Norway braced for major snow: 39 cm expected in the week ahead
item.description: Norway's snow cover is growing fast. Up to 39 cm of new snow is forecast over the next seven days, with the heaviest fall on November 20.

item.title: Polish snow cover down 590 km² in seven days: Karpacz leads
item.description: Poland's snow-covered area shrank from 1,300 to 710 km² in a week. Karpacz holds the deepest snow at 36 cm as of 17 November.

item.title: Slovakia: snow line at 1,200 m as early-season cover melts back
item.description: Slovakia's snow cover dropped to 1,830 km2 today. Snow sits mostly above 1,200 m; the High Tatras and Low Tatras lead with 8 cm of new snow in 72 hours.

item.title: 59 Swedish ski resorts now have snow cover across their terrain
item.description: 79% of Sweden's ski areas show snow today. Upper slopes at Björkliden and Abisko carry 131 cm. The Hemavan fjells led the past 72 hours with 15 cm of fresh snow.

item.title: Alpine snow distribution after the storm: Valais Alps lead with 92 cm in 72 hours
item.description: Fresh snow fell unevenly across Swiss mountains. The Valais Alps received 92 cm in three days; the Bernese Oberland 54 cm. Data from 17 November.

item.title: UK snow cover surged 6,810 km² in seven days
item.description: UK gained 8,380 km² of snow cover by 17 November. The North Pennines led with 27 cm in 72 hours.

item.title: Ukraine 6% white, Poland 11%: Carpathian snow divide widening
item.description: Ukraine's snow cover dropped to 6% today as the Carpathians melt back. Poland holds twice the white share. Both countries face fresh snow by Friday.

item.title: 22 Czech resorts have snow above 1000 m: where the white patches are
item.description: Only 22 of 170 Czech ski areas show snow cover on 17 November. The Jeseníky and Krkonoše lead with 9 cm and 8 cm in 72 hours. More snow arrives from 20 November.

item.title: Slovenia 6 % snow cover, Austria triple at 34 %: the Alpine divide
item.description: Slovenia has only 6 % white cover today against Austria's 34 %. Fresh snow in the Julian Alps offers the best chance for early season runs. Data from 17 November.

item.title: Orelle tracks the normal 42 cm path as November snow arrives
item.description: Orelle holds 42 cm, close to the typical 53 cm for mid-November. Fresh snow forecast across the Alps over the next three days.

item.title: Les Arcs 96 cm incoming; snowy three days ahead
item.description: 96 cm of new snow forecast for Les Arcs over the next three days, with today bringing the heaviest falls; model run November 16.

item.title: Western Canada: Where did 76 cm of fresh snow fall?
item.description: Whistler Blackcomb saw 76 cm of new snow in the last 72 hours, with Mount Cain Alpine Park also receiving 64 cm, as of November 16, 2026.

item.title: Andorra 2 %, France 11 %: snow divide on the ridge
item.description: On 16 November, Andorra has snow cover on just 2 % of its area while France climbs to 11 %; the gap reflects autumn patterns, with deeper falls forecast next week.

item.title: How many Austrian resorts have snow cover? 215 of 277
item.description: 215 of 277 Austrian ski resorts have early-season snow on 16 November. The snow line sits at 1500 metres; expect 50 cm in the next week.

item.title: Borovets 5 cm: Bulgaria at 2% coverage, Romania at 10%
item.description: Bulgaria covers just 2% in white with 5 cm at Borovets on its first snow day, while Romania shows 10%, measured 2026-11-16
